required_concepts: number of sides equals number of lines of symmetry
acceptable_paraphrases: each side is the same length
symmetry equal to the number of sides
critical_errors: incorrect statement about lines of symmetry
misconceptions: only some regular hexagons have equal sides
the number of lines of symmetry is not always the same as the number of sides
lines of symmetry are related to angles, not just sides
non-regular polygons can also have an equal number of sides and lines of symmetry
grading_notes: Credit will be given for correct phrasings that convey the core concepts. Deduct points for introducing unrelated ideas or misconceptions.
